36.text: despised and oppressed by all their neighbors, who call to the “spirits,” and

37.text: with their assistance become strong men and powerful shamans.

38.text: The single means used by the Chukchee shamans, novice or experienced,

39.text: for communication with “spirits,” is the beating of the drum and singing.
